name: 星轨来信
art: A cinematic original anime key visual, not a wallpaper texture. An adult female star-mail courier, about 24, with a short silver-blue bob, bright clear eyes and an ivory flight jacket with navy trim. Show a three-quarter shoulder portrait in the UPPER RIGHT, face centered at 74% width and 12% height, looking gently left toward the calendar. Hands out of frame. Her hair and jacket form a strong silhouette; the lower body dissolves into reflected station lights along the right edge. A futuristic railway platform curves through the bottom quarter, an illuminated train disappears toward a rose-colored horizon, deep cobalt night and huge drifting star trails above. Crisp controlled cel shading, selective soft painted light, sophisticated anime film color keys. Main read zone is atmospheric dark navy platform shadow with broad reflections, NOT an empty flat slab. Distinct rose light on hair, cyan rail lines, warm tiny windows only in the outer edges. Mood: departure, anticipation, a private letter carried across the stars.

name: 海盐汽水
art: A fresh original anime summer travel illustration with a confident editorial composition. An adult traveler, about 23, with a short turquoise bob, white sun hat and loose cream-and-coral summer jacket, shoulders and face in the upper right. The face is unobstructed at x74%, y12%, hands out of frame; she looks left with an easy thoughtful expression. Bright turquoise sea, huge sculpted white summer clouds, distant train tracks along the coast, a coral parasol and a glass soda bottle cropped into the lower left corner. Crisp sky-blue contour drawing, hand-painted gouache shadows, warm sunlight, saturated seafoam and coral accents. Central reading area remains a luminous low-detail cloud reflection over sea, not empty beige. Strong cloud silhouette and bold diagonals; tangible summer air and transparent bottle highlights. No school uniform, no chibi proportions, no franchise resemblance.

name: 雨夜霓虹
art: A cinematic cyberpunk night city, dense and unmistakable. Extreme vertical architecture frames a rain-soaked street canyon; a giant magenta light ring and a cyan cantilever tower dominate the upper-right quarter. Ground-level perspective sweeps from bottom left toward a distant vanishing point. Wet asphalt reflects hot magenta, electric cyan and ultraviolet; vapor drifts between brutalist buildings. No people, no writing on signs: all signage consists of abstract luminous shapes. High-end hard-surface environment illustration, sharp architecture and bloom used only on select edge lights. The calendar reading zone is the deep violet atmospheric void between towers, with broad reflected ribbons beneath it; the art must still cover the full frame. A few crisp angular technical strokes at margins, no fake HUD labels or microscopic interface clutter. Mood: rain, electricity, sleepless city.

name: 机甲协议
art: An original Japanese hard-surface mecha design as a premium industrial calendar skin. A large white ceramic and gunmetal robot head is anchored in the upper-right quarter at x75%, y13%, three-quarter view looking left; a thin amber optical visor, asymmetric cheek armor and exposed dark joints. It must not resemble a recognizable franchise robot. Cropped shoulder armor creates a diagonal at the lower left; a large orange hydraulic assembly and charcoal structural ribs frame the bottom. White enamel, titanium grey, charcoal and safety orange, clean product lighting, precise cel-rendered edges with realistic restrained wear. Center is a light frosted engineering-glass space with very faint broad blueprint geometry underneath, no dense lines under date text. Angular chamfer accents and carefully placed hazard stripes at extreme corners. No numbers, warnings, serial codes, logos or pseudo-text.

name: 千里青绿
art: A sumptuous original Chinese blue-green shanshui landscape in mineral pigment, visibly richer than a pale ink wash. Monumental malachite and azurite mountains rise through the lower third and climb the right edge. Thin warm-gold contour lines trace ridges and a winding river; white cranes cross the upper-right sky, one large graceful crane becomes the top focal silhouette. Dense meticulous brushwork and tiny architectural details are concentrated at the mountain bases, with broad pale jade clouds occupying the calendar reading area. Rich emerald, lapis blue, pale celadon and antique gold. Flat decorative depth inspired by traditional handscroll composition, presented as a contemporary luxury editorial surface. The center remains scenic mist and distant low-contrast mountain silhouettes, not a blank frame. No calligraphy, stamps, labels or copied historic painting.

name: 敦煌飞天
art: An original Dunhuang-inspired mural composition with a graceful adult celestial dancer floating through the upper-right quarter. Her face is calm, fine and clear at x75%, y12%; she wears flowing turquoise and cinnabar silk, with one long ribbon descending along the right edge and curling across the bottom. Above her, a cropped geometric caisson rosette in muted gold anchors the top corner; below, stylized lotus petals and desert-colored cloud forms create an asymmetric decorative rhythm. Mineral pigments on aged sandstone plaster, matte ochre, turquoise, vermilion and antique gold, subtle weathered texture. A rich designed mural, not a generic mandala. The central reading zone is warm softly lit plaster and low-contrast drifting silk shadows, without figure faces under the calendar dates. No religious lettering, calligraphy, symbols pretending to be text or logos.

name: 鹤月长安
art: A richly composed nocturnal Chinese palace garden. A huge ivory moon occupies the upper-right sky, partially crossed by a white crane in a confident elegant silhouette. Layered dark jade palace roofs sweep diagonally upward from the lower-left quarter; a small cluster of glowing cinnabar lanterns hangs along the far right, their warm reflections moving through an ink-dark pond. Fine antique-gold linework on roof ridges and cloud contours, deep peacock green, charcoal teal, moon ivory and restrained scarlet. The central calendar area is a broad midnight pond and soft cloud shadow, low-frequency but still part of the scene. Painterly meticulous gongbi detail at architecture edges, cinematic moonlight and warm lantern contrast. No people, no calligraphy, no written couplets, no generic red festive wallpaper.

name: 星舰航图
art: Hard-science-fiction orbital navigation visual. A massive aquamarine ringed exoplanet rises from the lower-right quarter, with an elegant orbital station silhouetted above its limb. Its thin cyan atmospheric edge and sweeping pale-gold orbit arcs travel along the frame margins. A cropped docking ring and white ceramic hull structure anchor the upper-right corner. Center is deep desaturated blue space with a broad faint nebula, not a flat blank; tiny stars are sparse and never form constellations resembling text. Accurate-looking engineering, strong scale, controlled cinematic rim light, dark navy, pale ice blue and selective amber. High-end spacecraft mission-control aesthetic with only a few crisp unlabeled vector-like lines, no numerals, instrument readouts, graticule grid, HUD text or logos.

name: 梦游糖果城
art: An imaginative premium 3D clay illustration, playful but carefully art-directed. A sculptural candy city with lilac arches, coral stairways, mint rounded towers and translucent peach glass spheres wraps around the sides. A large original tiny white astronaut mascot with over-ear lavender headphones peeks from the upper-right corner, its simple expressive visor face at x76%, y12%; it is a new character, not an existing cartoon. A sweeping pink clay ribbon bridge crosses the lower quarter, with one oversized satin star and an apricot cloud. Tactile matte clay, soft ambient occlusion, small glossy glass highlights, warm studio light. Central reading area is luminous lavender sky and a faint floating cloud, with generous spacing between sculptural forms; no objects directly beneath the date heading. Vivid candy accents, not washed-out pastel wallpaper. No text, letters, printed UI or stickers.

name: 深海之书
art: A magnificent original art-nouveau deep-sea illustration, like a living illuminated book. A large luminous jellyfish bell blooms in the upper-right quarter, turquoise bioluminescence rimmed in antique gold; its graceful tentacles descend along the right edge. An elegant octopus arm and intricate coral fronds curl around the bottom-left quarter, weaving into flowing asymmetrical gold linework. Deep emerald water, peacock teal, warm old gold, pearl-green light and a few coral-orange sparks. Strong silhouette and exceptional ornamental drawing, stained-glass-like color separations blended with rich painted volume. Central calendar reading area is dark clear water with slow broad shafts of light; no tentacle crossings, dots or dense detail under the date numbers. Ornate and mysterious, not horror, not photoreal wildlife, no lettering or book pages with words.
